in_sanskrit.name: जागेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who conquers the mind, the inner enemy, and achieves self-realization.

in_telugu.name: జాగేశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: జేశముదే (One who has the power of Jyestha, the goddess of victory).

in_marathi.name: Jagesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jagesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ja means victory, Ge means bringer, and Shah means king or ruler. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is popular in Hindu culture.

in_bengali.name: Jagesh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Victory Bringer
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jagesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Ja means victory, Ge means bringer, and Shah means king or ruler. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is popular in Hindu culture.
